in_marathi.name: Narendr
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narendr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Narendr is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name formed by combining the words 'Nara' (man) and 'Indra' (god of rain, thunderbolt, and sky). This name signifies one who is the charioteer of Lord Indra, the deity who rides the chariot drawn by horses, elephants, and Gandharvas. In Hindu mythology, Indra is considered as the god of rain and thunder, and Narendr's name signifies being a devoted servant or follower of Lord Indra.
